ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in parallelogram $ABCD$, point $E$ is on $AD$. Connect $CE$ and extend it to intersect the extension of $BA$ at point $F$. If $AE: AD = 2:3$ and $CD = 3$ cm, what is the length of $AF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that quadrilateral ABCD is a parallelogram,\\
it follows that AB $\parallel$ CD,\\
which implies $\triangle AFE \sim \triangle DEC$,\\
hence AE : DE = AF : CD,\\
given AE : AD = 2 : 3,\\
it follows that AE : DE = 2 : 1,\\
since CD = 3 cm,\\
we have AF = 2CD = \boxed{6cm}.
